[7Oct15] From now on Gresham’s will be using UKiset as our sole entrance test. Your students will be able to take the test before registering for our school. Please continue to send us student profiles in the first instance and we will give you a ‘yes’ or ‘no’ to the student taking the test. The student will only be required to register with Gresham’s should they pass the UKiset test and they are invited to be interviewed. 
This new procedure will speed up the application process and it means we will be in a position to make offers to your students immediately.
[14Aug14] Gresham’s will accept UKiset results as part of our assessment and we encourage your students to take the test as an initial indicator of their academic ability.  However, there is NO OBLIGATION for students applying to Gresham’s for 2015 entry to take UKiset. Whilst we would prefer to receive UKiset results with an initial application, we will also accept applications without this assessment. We will continue to ask all candidates to undertake our own entrance tests in Maths and English. This is to offer the greatest amount of consistency in our assessment process. However, we will be continuing to review our assessment process during the course of the year. 

[12Feb14] for September 2015, we will continue to offer both the International Baccalaureate Diploma and A Levels.

[24Aug12]Gresham’s will be offering solely the IB in the Sixth Form from September 2015. The switch to IB only will coincide with the opening of our new Sixth Form Centre for Sept 2015, which is a considerable investment for the School.
 
More information can be downloaded from this website: http://www.greshams.biz/flipbooks/sixthform/sthef/index.html
